unchanged_findings.title: Routed interface has no interface ACL detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: FastEthernet0/1 has an IP address but no ip access-group command was detected in the interface block.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Check the intended trust boundary and firewall/routing policy; an interface ACL is not required on every interface.

unchanged_findings.title: AAA new-model not detected
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Assess centralized AAA (for example TACACS+ or RADIUS) for managed environments; local-only designs may be intentional.

unchanged_findings.title: Login failure throttling not detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No login block-for command was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Where supported, configure login failure blocking based on operational policy.

unchanged_findings.title: Log timestamps not explicitly configured
unchanged_findings.evidence: No service timestamps log datetime command was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Enable useful timestamps for event correlation where supported.
unchanged_findings.remediation_example: service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone

unchanged_findings.title: Remote syslog destination not detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No logging host/IP command was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Consider sending logs to a protected central syslog/SIEM service; verify reachability and access controls.

unchanged_findings.title: Login or MOTD banner not detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No login, motd, or exec banner was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Use an organization-approved access warning banner where policy or law requires it.

unchanged_findings.title: Source-routing protection not explicit
unchanged_findings.evidence: no ip source-route was not found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Confirm the platform default and explicitly disable source routing if supported by policy.

unchanged_findings.title: NTP server not detected
unchanged_findings.evidence: No ntp server command was found.
unchanged_findings.recommendation: Configure approved time sources so logs can be correlated across devices.

limitations: Comparison is based on rule_id and target/interface when present.
A lower heuristic risk score does not prove the network is secure.
Validate the configuration and connectivity in an isolated lab after changes.
